subject: MAP: Security gate schedule & DPA redline — onboarding timeline for SolsticeFin
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <l.park@solsticefin.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@solsticefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Security gate schedule & DPA redline — onboarding timeline for SolsticeFin

Hi Lydia / Marco —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As discussed, I’m consolidating the mutual action plan (MAP) items that touch security/compliance so we have a single timeline for evidence delivery and contract close. Goal: pin a readable schedule so your engineering and procurement teams can align with ours.

Summary / asks:
- Deliverables we need from SolsticeFin: SOC 2 Type II report (latest), completed SIG/CAIQ (spreadsheet), answers to the data residency matrix, and any DPA exceptions you require.
- Redwood commitments: provide our SOC 2 coverage statement, sample retention settings by deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), and a DPA redline for your review by EOD tomorrow.

Suggested MAP milestones (first cut):
1) Security intake — SolsticeFin delivers SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 (due: 2027-03-05)
2) Evidence review — Redwood requests clarifications (due: 2027-03-10)
3) DPA negotiation — exchange redlines and finalize (target sign: 2027-03-18)
4) Environment readiness & data residency confirmation (target: 2027-03-22)
5) Go/no-go and production enablement (target: 2027-03-29)

Quick clarifications we need now to avoid rework:
- Retention windows: can you confirm the default retention target for PII-derived logs and model telemetry? (30 / 90 / custom?)
- SIG: will you complete the full CAIQ or do you want us to accept a partial (control-level) response?

Attachments I will drop shortly: DPA_redline_Redwood_v3.docx and a MAP spreadsheet with milestone owners. We can move the evidence exchange into the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2C3-SolsticeOnboarding

Next steps: Lydia — please push the SOC2 + SIG by Friday so Ben and I can triage evidence early next week. Marco — loop in procurement for DPA timeline expectations. Neha — I’ll flag legal comments once the redline is posted.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales (Security Accounts)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_redline_Redwood_v3.docx (redline), MAP_SolsticeFin_v1.xlsx (milestones)

From: Lydia Park <l.park@solsticefin.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@solsticefin.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security gate schedule & DPA redline — onboarding timeline for SolsticeFin

Thanks Rachel —

We can get you the SIG/CAIQ and latest SOC 2 Type II report by 2027-03-04. Attached is a preliminary SIG spreadsheet with answers to the higher-risk controls; we’ll complete remaining entries by EOD Thursday. A couple of notes from our side:

- Retention: Default production telemetry retention is 90 days; logs with sensitive PII are retained for 30 days unless a contract requires longer. We will mark any exception requests.
- Data residency: Primary tenancy is us-east-1; we have EU options but would need an SLA addendum for EU residency.

Questions for Redwood:
1) For SOC 2 evidence review, do you accept screenshots + system exports for first pass, or do you require signed auditor attestations for all items?
2) For the DPA redline, any mandatory clauses we should expect (KMS/HSM integration notes, subprocessors list)?

Attaching: SIG-CAIQ-responses-v1.xlsx, SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf (redacted).

Regards,
Lydia
Lydia Park
Head of InfoSec
SolsticeFin

Attachment stubs: SIG-CAIQ-responses-v1.xlsx, SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Park <l.park@solsticefin.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@solsticefin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security gate schedule & DPA redline — onboarding timeline for SolsticeFin

Appreciate the fast turn, Lydia. Quick internal readouts / proposals:

- Evidence policy: first-pass reviews can accept screenshots + export artifacts (logs, console exports) for low-risk controls. For high-risk (crypto key management, access evidence to production), we’ll require auditor attestation or signed statements. We’ll flag those specifically.
- Suggested acceptance criteria (MAP step 2): all high-risk controls verified OR an agreed mitigation plan with owners and dates.

I updated the MAP spreadsheet with an "evidence acceptance" column and owner tags. Proposed hard dates:
- Evidence upload into Drive: 2027-03-05 (SolsticeFin)
- Redwood review complete: 2027-03-11
- Final DPA sign: 2027-03-19

Operational ask: if you prefer, we can stage initial traffic on Dedicated capacity (isolated pool) pending DPA finalization; that buys time on the retention SLA and audit windows.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Security (Redwood)

On a side note, Lydia — please confirm whether your SOC2 report includes the "cloud services" subservice description; that affects what evidence we need for multi-tenant hosted flows.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Park <l.park@solsticefin.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security gate schedule & DPA redline — onboarding timeline for SolsticeFin

Folks —

I reviewed Rachel's redline and pushed a version with clarifying language around retention carveouts and subprocessors. Key points:
- Redwood proposes preserving customer-requested retention windows at contract level (Section 4a). If SolsticeFin requires >90 days for telemetry, we’ll add a retention SLT (special retention term) and note potential cost exposure for hosted API storage.
- We accept a partial SIG/CAIQ for low-risk controls during an initial go-live, provided high-risk controls are fully answered.
- We need a subprocessors list added to DPA Exhibit B; SolsticeFin should confirm whether their procurement requires a separate security questionnaire for our infra providers.

I've uploaded DPA_redline_Redwood_v3.docx to the Drive and initiated a DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/regions/emp/DS12345-DPA — Rachel, please confirm if procurement wants us to route directly to Marco for countersign.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: DPA_redline_Redwood_v3.docx

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <l.park@solsticefin.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@solsticefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Security gate schedule & DPA redline — onboarding timeline for SolsticeFin

Thanks everyone — quick alignment and next steps below.

1) Lydia/Marco: Appreciate SOC2 + partial SIG. Please upload the remaining SIG entries and confirm the PII retention exception requests (if any) by 2027-03-04 COB. That keeps MAP milestone 1 intact.
2) Ben/Neha: We’ll triage high-risk controls first after the upload; Ben will lead the evidence review and flag any auditor-level asks by 2027-03-08.
3) DPA: Neha has posted the redline and started the DocuSign. Marco — please route to procurement; if you need to counter-redline, we can do a 48-hour turnaround once we have your comments.

Updated MAP (live): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2C3-SolsticeOnboarding — I added an "open issues" tab and a column for "acceptance criteria" per Ben's suggestion.

Milestone summary (finalized dates):
- SIG + SOC2 upload: 2027-03-04
- Redwood evidence review complete: 2027-03-11
- DPA signed: 2027-03-19
- Environment residency confirmed: 2027-03-22
- Production enablement (soft): 2027-03-30

If any timing on your side slips by more than 48 hours, please call out here and we’ll propose a recovery cadence (can include staging on Dedicated capacity).

Best,
Rachel
